headlines.title: DOJ sues to block Alaska Senate certification if GOP’s Dan Sullivan loses
headlines.description: The Justice Department is suing Alaska election officials to prevent them from certifying Senate race results if GOP Sen. Dan Sullivan loses next month.

headlines.title: Israel orders full West Bank 'lockdown' after deadly shooting attack
headlines.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ordered the Israel Defense Forces to impose a closure of the city of Hebron and also told them to prepare for a "full lockdown" of the occupied West Bank. NBC News' Matt Bradley reports the latest on the situation.

headlines.title: World Series set to start as potential MLB lockout or strike looms for next season
headlines.description: With the World Series starting soon, owners and players will head to the negotiating table to figure out the next collective bargaining agreement. If neither side can come to an agreement, the 2027 season may be in jeopardy. NBC News' Steven Romo reports.

headlines.title: Hero who stopped Bend school shooter haunted by encounter: ‘I didn’t save everybody’
headlines.description: Kaylub Giamanco speaks for the first time about the day he brought down a school shooter in Bend, Oregon.

headlines.title: 'Wildwood' embraces handmade artistry in the age of AI
headlines.description: LAIKA Studios spent over six years crafting "Wildwood" by hand— 233 puppets, 1,000-plus artists, and zero AI. As the film earns Oscar buzz, animators say handmade art is having a resurgence. NBC News' Chloe Melas reports.

headlines.title: Trump hopes to flatter Putin into negotiating on Ukraine
headlines.description: A Trump diplomat called Putin “a humanitarian,” another in a recent flurry of overtures to the Russian leader. But it’s unclear whether blandishments will entice him to strike a deal.

headlines.title: Debbie Shields speaks out on her viral moment riffing with Conan O'Brien
headlines.description: Internet sensation Debbie Shields speaks with NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian about her recent viral video, where she stood out during an improvised conversation with Conan O'Brien on the popular internet talk show “Subway Takes.”
